metadata.description: Agent plugin for developing Windows apps with the winapp CLI. Scaffold WinUI/XAML apps, find WinUI controls and Windows APIs, inspect and automate desktop app UIs, configure Windows SDK and Windows App SDK access, and package, sign, and distribute apps with MSIX. Supports WinUI, Electron, .NET (WPF, WinForms, and MAUI), C++, Rust, Flutter, and Tauri.
